intuition: A breadth-first traversal groups nodes by depth, allowing each level's sum to be divided by its node count.

brute_force.approach: For each depth, traverse the whole tree and collect nodes at that depth.

optimal.approach: Process a queue one level-sized batch at a time and compute its average.

edge_cases: A single-node tree has one average equal to its root value.
The final level may contain only one node.
Use floating-point division for level means.
